meta.summary: A high-spirited 3-day family wedding balancing Rajasthani heritage hospitality with disciplined middle-class budget allocation and vendor coordination.

budgetBreakdown.name: Catering & Banquet Hall
budgetBreakdown.note: Primary cost for 250 guests across 3 days: Welcome lunch, Sangeet live chaat, Haldi snacks, and Royal Wedding feast.

budgetBreakdown.name: Decor & Floral Stage
budgetBreakdown.note: Marigold draping, fairytale lighting canopy, and Mandap floral structure. High savings potential with mandi flowers.

budgetBreakdown.name: Photography & Cinematic Reels
budgetBreakdown.note: 2 candid photographers, 1 traditional videographer, drone coverage during Varmala, and edited teaser reels.

budgetBreakdown.name: Outfits & Groom/Bridal Styling
budgetBreakdown.note: Bridal lehenga, groom sherwani, family coordinated turbans (safas), and professional bridal makeup artist.

budgetBreakdown.name: DJ, Sound System & Dhol
budgetBreakdown.note: Baraat Punjabi dhol ensemble, Sangeet sound mixer console, wireless mics, and ambient uplighting.

budgetBreakdown.name: E-Invites, Mithai & Return Gifts
budgetBreakdown.note: Custom animated WhatsApp invites + 150 artisanal dry-fruit & traditional jharokha sweet boxes for elders.

budgetBreakdown.name: Logistics & Pandit Buffer
budgetBreakdown.note: Airport/station guest pickup cabs, emergency vendor overtime, puja samagri, and panditji dakshina.

schedule.details: Check-in at heritage haveli guestrooms; welcome drinks and rose petal shower.
Intimate henna application with local Rajasthani folk singer and dholak.
Choreographed family dance performances, DJ party, live chaat and jalebi counters.
Organic turmeric paste rituals with marigold flower petal shower and dhol beats.
Groom arrival with vintage open jeep, brass band, and family safa tying at the gates.

schedule.activity: Grand Varmala Exchange under Floral Canopy
schedule.details: Milni ceremony between families followed by sunset Varmala with pyrotechnic fountains.
Vedic vows around the holy fire followed by traditional Rajasthani Daal Baati Churma and multi-cuisine dinner.
Puffed rice throwing ritual, heartfelt elder blessings, and decorated car departure.
Light brunch (Poha, Kachori, fresh fruits) and distribution of mithai boxes to departing relatives.

vendorChecklist.task: Lock in final per-plate menu (minimum 4 live counters + 2 traditional desserts)
vendorChecklist.tip: Negotiate complimentary breakfast for 50 close relatives staying at the venue.

vendorChecklist.task: Confirm sound limiter policy, diesel generator backup, and air cooling setup
vendorChecklist.tip: Check exact curfew time for outdoor music (usually 10:00 PM by local police norms).

vendorChecklist.task: Provide family member VIP list and finalize teaser reel turnaround time (within 72 hrs)
vendorChecklist.tip: Ask for drone license verification to avoid venue restrictions during Varmala.

vendorChecklist.task: Approve stage 3D render and switch imported lilies to Indian marigolds/tuberoses
vendorChecklist.tip: Directly ask if the floral framework can be repurposed from Haldi to Reception.

vendorChecklist.task: Submit curated Bollywood/Punjabi Sangeet playlist and sound check wireless mics
vendorChecklist.tip: Ensure sound technician is physically present near the stage for immediate troubleshooting.

vendorChecklist.task: Receive complete puja samagri checklist and confirm exact Shubh Muhurat for Pheras
vendorChecklist.tip: Appoint one responsible cousin/uncle in advance to handle the puja material delivery.

personalizedIdeas.title: Direct Mandi Floral Sourcing (Save ₹40,000)
personalizedIdeas.description: Send a trusted family friend to the local morning wholesale flower mandi at 5:00 AM to buy bulk Marigolds and Rajnigandha. Hand over to your local decorator to slash markup by 40%.

personalizedIdeas.title: Tabletop QR 'Live Memory Cloud'
personalizedIdeas.description: Place small wooden tent cards on every dinner table with a printed QR code. Guests scan without app downloads to upload candid moments into your private family Google Drive folder.

personalizedIdeas.title: Royal Kulhad Chai & Street Chaat Welcome
personalizedIdeas.description: Ditch overpriced branded mocktails. Greet incoming relatives with hot ginger-cardamom tea in clay Kulhads and freshly fried mini pyaaz kachoris for authentic Rajasthani warmth.

personalizedIdeas.title: Animated WhatsApp Video Invites (Save ₹35,000)
personalizedIdeas.description: Skip bulky printed card boxes and courier delays. Use custom illustrated digital video invites with the couple's voiceover, reserving printed cards solely for the senior-most elders.

personalizedIdeas.title: Repurposed Haldi-to-Sangeet Props
personalizedIdeas.description: Use brass Urlis with floating yellow flowers and bright bandhani dupattas for morning Haldi, then add tealights and brass lanterns at dusk for an enchanting Sangeet photobooth.
